title: Fablehaven
author: Brandon Mull
summary: Two siblings sent to stay at their grandparents' remote estate find that it is a hidden preserve for magical creatures. When they break the rules, the gentle fairies and sprites turn out to hold back darker things.
readIf: you want a fun, quick middle-grade fantasy full of fairies, trolls, demons and secrets.
skipIf: you want sophisticated prose or darker stakes, as it is plainly written for younger readers.

pairings.reason: Another fast, fun kids' fantasy where a hidden magical world turns out to be real.
A more famous story of children finding a hidden world with rules and a growing threat.
A shorter, creepier book if you like children's fantasy with something unsettling beneath the surface.
